description: This file defines the ProspectFormBase class which provides form handling logic for Prospect entities in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for generating HTML forms, checking for duplicate prospects, and saving prospect data.

classes.name: ProspectFormBase
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate and handle prospect-related forms, including duplicate checking and saving functionality in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: checkForDuplicates
methods.description: Checks for duplicate prospects based on name and email fields, returning matching records.

methods.name: buildTableForm
methods.description: Builds an HTML table form displaying potential duplicate prospect records for user selection.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Generates HTML form body for wide prospect input form, with address and contact fields.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Generates a simple HTML form body for prospect input or editing, tailored for email editing views.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Produces complete HTML form for creating or editing a prospect, including headers and submit button.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes submitted form data to save a prospect record, handling duplicates and redirects.
